build_evidence.mass_change_reason: Allocate 50% of certified UK national household prior mass to the rebuilt 2022-23 SPI support channel; total national mass is conserved.

frs_epb_source_absent.finding: Missing. EXPBEN* are receipt flags, and the amount fields cover only selected benefits; they cannot produce complete taxable expenses payments and benefits.
frs_epb_source_absent.mass_implication: 12.9485464% of certified-candidate FRS effective person mass has at least one receipt flag, but this is not monetary support.
frs_epb_source_absent.rationale: Receipt flags and selected benefit amounts cannot be promoted to the SPI EPB monetary concept without an imputation or proxy.

frs_exps_source_absent.finding: Missing. These fields describe reimbursements or payroll deductions, not the complete tax-deductible employment-expense amount required by SPI.
frs_exps_source_absent.mass_implication: 5.1302528% of certified-candidate FRS effective person mass has an adjacent reimbursement flag; the true EXPS mass is not estimable.
frs_exps_source_absent.rationale: The nearby fields do not measure the required deductible amount, and EXPS enters the employed-income identity with a negative sign.

frs_mothinc_source_absent.finding: Missing. The fields are heterogeneous and belong to distinct income concepts; assigning their union to SPI miscellaneous employment income would be a proxy.
frs_mothinc_source_absent.mass_implication: Odd-job-only effective person mass is 0.1724207%; the broader unresolved miscellaneous pool is 1.4650566%.
frs_mothinc_source_absent.rationale: The FRS instrument cannot separate the SPI miscellaneous-employment concept source-faithfully.

frs_ossben_identifiable_subset.finding: Incomplete. Carer's Allowance and contribution-based ESA form an identifiable subset, but code 6 mixes tax treatments and code 30 is an undifferentiated catch-all, so the complete taxable family cannot be emitted.
frs_ossben_identifiable_subset.mass_implication: 1.8045088% of certified-candidate FRS effective person mass carries the identifiable lower-bound subset; it is not full OSSBEN support.
frs_ossben_identifiable_subset.rationale: The retained column must remain explicitly named as a subset and cannot satisfy the full SPI concept.

frs_otherinc_source_absent.finding: Missing. No person-level raw FRS variable has SPI OTHERINC semantics, and the miscellaneous pool cannot be split between MOTHINC and OTHERINC from source evidence.
frs_otherinc_source_absent.mass_implication: No separable mass estimate exists; the unresolved miscellaneous pool is 1.4650566% of certified-candidate FRS effective person mass.
frs_otherinc_source_absent.rationale: A union of heterogeneous residual fields would be a new proxy, not a retained source constituent.
raw_sources_searched: ADULT, ODDJOB, and JOB miscellaneous fields

frs_srp_regular_code5_subset.finding: Incomplete. Code 5 supplies regular State Pension, but the FRS source does not identify the full SPI combination of State Pension lump sums and widow's pension; code 6 mixes benefits and code 9 is tax-free War Widow's Pension.
frs_srp_regular_code5_subset.mass_implication: 18.1567916% of certified-candidate FRS effective person mass carries regular code-5 State Pension; it is not complete SRP support.
frs_srp_regular_code5_subset.rationale: The retained column must remain explicitly named as a subset and cannot be reported as the full published state-pension measure.

frs_taxterm_source_absent.finding: Missing. REDAMT is gross redundancy pay and has neither the taxable amount nor non-redundancy termination pay.
frs_taxterm_source_absent.mass_implication: 0.3746084% of certified-candidate FRS effective person mass has positive gross redundancy pay; taxable mass is unknown.
frs_taxterm_source_absent.rationale: Gross redundancy pay cannot be relabeled as taxable termination pay.
raw_sources_searched: ADULT and JOB taxable-termination split search

full_frs_tei_band_unavailable.finding: The complete FRS TEI measure cannot be materialized from retained source constituents, so exact HMRC total-income band assignment is unavailable on the FRS channel.
full_frs_tei_band_unavailable.mass_implication: Every one of the 208 published facts is banded by total income and therefore depends on this unavailable like-for-like measure.
full_frs_tei_band_unavailable.rationale: A component-level subset does not imply a per-band lower bound: omitted income can move a taxpayer into or out of any non-overlapping published band. Biased partial bands are not emitted as estimates.

ossben_identifiable_subset.formula: sum(BENAMT where BENEFIT == 13 or (BENEFIT == 16 and VAR2 in {1, 3})) * (365.25 / 7)
